basic_info.description: Experience the best of San Francisco in this beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath Edwardian home, thoughtfully designed across two levels. Located in the heart of NoPa, this light-filled TIC offers an ideal blend of classic architectural details and modern upgrades. The open chef's kitchen with dining area features granite counters, stainless steel appliances, stone backsplash and a wine fridge, perfect for entertaining. The formal living room boasts elegant bay windows and a decorative fireplace. The lower-level family room is highlighted with large custom built-in and is an extension of the luxurious primary suite with spa-inspired bath. French doors open out to the sunny tranquil landscaped garden where you can sit around the fire pit, barbecue, relax in the sun while being surrounded by beautiful greenery and flowers. Additional highlights include hardwood floors, high ceilings, crown moldings, window coverings, in-unit laundry, private storage, and leased parking. Fractional financing available. Enjoy a variety of amazing restaurants in the Divisadero corridor. Close proximity to Panhandle Park, Alamo Square Park, Buena Vista Park, Golden Gate Park and conveniently located to nearby tech shuttle stops and public transportation. Walkscore 97. City living at its best!
